crossRefs.note: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,
Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons…
Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
